correctness.rationale: The shell partition is exact under both maps, including launch probabilities from a uniform upper-half point. Two absorbing boundaries give a unique finite tridiagonal Dirichlet solution; summing the geometric launch distribution yields all special parameter formulas. Dominant powers establish the four fixed-p regimes; explicit removable-quotient analysis establishes both critical scaling limits. A separately programmed rational linear-system solver agreed with the closed form in 112 exact (p,m) cases. Boundaries p=1/2,2/3,1 and m=1 are checked; no finite experiment was used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The observable is the full deepest-penetration statistic of completed intermittent excursions, which measures rare close approaches to the neutral fixed point and is distinct from return length and density. The exact distribution reveals two structurally different phase transitions, p=1/2 (recurrence) and p=2/3 (geometric reinjection resonance), plus quantitative finite-size crossover functions at both. It supplies a benchmark for extreme-event analysis in a canonical random dynamical system, rather than an arbitrary isolated finite computation.
